message.content: LeBron James (born December 30, 1984) is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes ever. Known for his combination of size, athleticism, court vision, and scoring ability, he has earned four MVP awards, multiple All‑Star selections, and numerous league records. Off the court, LeBron is also known for philanthropy—including opening the “I Promise School” for at-risk children in Akron, Ohio—as well as ventures into film production, media ownership, and various business enterprises.
